svg.title: Career highway, 2015 to now
svg.desc: An elevated neon freeway with a highway sign per era. 2015 Anna University, B.E. Mechanical Engineering. 2016-2017 CVS Health, led API development. 2017-2018 Woolworths, Sydney, ASP.NET/C#. 2018-2019 McKesson, Flask and C# Web API. 2019-2022 Humana, specialty pharmacy, led the backend agile team, Tesseract OCR. 2022-2023 Agero, FastAPI on AWS Lambda. 2023-2025 Freddie Mac, led the backend team. 2025-2026 Capital One, 50+ AWS microservice platform. July 2026 to now: Freddie Mac, FastAPI on EKS/ECS serving ML forecasting models.
svg.text: The origin story: from gears to
From mechanical engineering to ML platforms. Nine exits, 2015 to now.
